newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostics in Canadian pact.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostics in Canadian pact.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said it has signed a letter of intent which allows Advanced Pathology Services Group of Cos Inc, based in London, to use and sell its rapid HIV blood and saliva-based diagnostic tests.
The agreement was signed with the Advanced Pathology Services Canada Inc, an Edmonton, Alberta-based member of the Advanced Pathology Services Group.
Saliva Diagnostic said its tests produce results in minutes without special training, storage or equipment.
APS Group intends to sell the rapid HIV blood and saliva-based tests through its global network of clinical laboratories and medical facilities.

"APS adds particular marketing strength in the Middle East, especially in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, where they operate 14 facilities," said Saliva Diagnostics President Kenneth McLachlan, in a statement. "But they will also be a major factor worldwide in bringing our products to the forefront of the rapid test market."
Saliva Diagnostics said it expects the agreement to be finalized before the end of March and at that time to begin to receive the first of substantial orders from APS Group.
APS Canada provides human and veterinary testing services, and maintains a laboratory for saliva testing.
Saliva Diagnostics develops and makes rapid diagnostic tests for infectious diseases and other conditions.
